items.title: Warren "Baby" Dodds Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: I sat around about 47, 48, Kay would have been a good musician.

ctx.x: Now I can see what a good guy he was. What type of band do you think he enjoyed working in most? The bigger band or the smaller groups? He worked so many smaller groups. Was that by choice or was it just because they usually only hired three or four? That's all they were hired. Because he knew he could get as much out of the three or four men and he couldn't win five or six. He couldn't get the harmony, but there was work the man got.
